description: Contains unit tests for the CachedGrainLocator class in Orleans, focusing on grain address registration, lookup, cache management, and handling of silo status changes.

classes.name: CachedGrainLocatorTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing CachedGrainLocator functionalities like registration, lookups, cache cleanup, and status handling.

classes.name: NoOpClusterManifestProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of IClusterManifestProvider that provides a static current cluster manifest for testing updates.

methods.name: RegisterWhenNoOtherEntryExists
methods.description: Tests registering a new grain address when no prior entry exists, verifying cache update.

methods.name: RegisterWhenOtherEntryExists
methods.description: Tests registration when an existing entry for the same GrainId exists, expects update.

methods.name: RegisterWhenOtherEntryExistsAndPreviousAddressMatches
methods.description: Tests registration with a matching previous address, expecting successful update.

methods.name: RegisterWhenOtherEntryExistsAndPreviousAddressDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Tests registration with a non-matching previous address, expecting no update.

methods.name: RegisterWhenOtherEntryExistsButSiloIsDead
methods.description: Ensures registration handles dead silo addresses by unregistering outdated entries and updating cache.

methods.name: LookupPopulateTheCache
methods.description: Verifies that a lookup populates the cache when the entry is retrieved remotely.

methods.name: LookupWhenEntryExistsButSiloIsDead
methods.description: Checks that lookup returns null and unregisters if the silo is dead.

methods.name: LocalLookupWhenEntryExistsButSiloIsDead
methods.description: Ensures local cache lookup does not call directory when entry's silo is dead.

methods.name: CleanupWhenSiloIsDead
methods.description: Tests that cache and directory cleanup properly when a silo is marked dead.

methods.name: UnregisterCallDirectoryAndCleanCache
methods.description: Checks that unregistering clears cache entries.

methods.name: UnregisterRemovesFromCacheFirst
methods.description: Verifies cache cleanup prior to directory call during unregister.

methods.name: UnregisterRacesWithLookupSameId
methods.description: Simulates a race condition where unregister races with a lookup of the same grain ID.

methods.name: UnregisterRacesWithLookupDifferentId
methods.description: Simulates a race condition with unregister and lookup of different grain IDs.

methods.name: GenerateGrainAddress
methods.description: Utility to generate a random GrainAddress with optional SiloAddress.

methods.name: GenerateSiloAddress
methods.description: Utility to generate new SiloAddress instances.

methods.name: WaitUntilClusterChangePropagated
methods.description: Utility to wait synchronously until cluster membership versions are updated.

methods.name: Until
methods.description: Repeatedly checks a condition until it is true or a timeout occurs.
